details.description:
Are you ready to suffer?
It's very dangerous to go
alone! You'll face a
freezing hell, I wish you
luck. I'll be kind enough
and give you a nice hint:
don't exploit it!

10 years ago a team of
hunters went to the gorge
to end the most fearsome
time that we had!
Now it's back again, you
must clear this task!
Good luck Hunter!

64554.objectiveJp: ラヴィエンテ１体の撃退

details.descriptionEn:
Emergency message from the
Parone Caravan! Near the Lone
Isle, a gigantic monster never
seen before has appeared, and
it is causing terrible damage
in the nearby waters. Every
Hunter able to move is to set
out by balloon, and once the
target is found, slay it.
details.descriptionJp:
パローネ＝キャラバンから
緊急連絡！≪絶島≫付近で、
見たこともない巨大なモンス
ターが現れ、近くの海域で
甚大な被害が出ているよう
です。動ける全てのハンター
は気球で出発し、目標を捕捉
し次第、討伐にあたってくだ
さい。
